points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法——GSAERU 模型。
points.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization—GSAERU model.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列。
在单时间步上将图快照输入图表征学习模块。
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩。
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器。
利用和原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征。
通过循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系。
在四个真实世界的大规模图数据集上进行了实验验证。
technical_features_en: Model the dynamic sequence graph as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each moment.
Input the graph snapshots into the graph representation learning module at a single time step.
Compress the original graph through the graph summarization technology.
Input the compressed new graph into the graph autoencoder.
Train the representation of the nodes of the original graph using the reconstruction error with the original graph.
Learn the feature information and dependencies of the original graph in the time dimension through a recurrent neural network.
Conducted experiments on four real-world large-scale graph datasets.

points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法——DSGNN 模型。
points.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm based on graph summaries——DSGNN model.
technical_features: 采用“领导——工作者”工作模式。
利用一个基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分。
将划分子图分配给各个工作节点。
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练。
通过注意力层返回训练结果给领导节点。
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度。
根据梯度同步更新所有计算节点上的模型。
在四个真实世界的大规模图数据集上进行了实验验证。
technical_features_en: Adopted the ”leader-worker” mode.
Divided the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation.
Assigned the divided subgraphs to each worker.
The workers performed a mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology.
Returned the training results to the leader through an attention layer.
Summarized the results and calculated the gradient by the leader.
Synchronously updated the models on all computing nodes according to the gradient.
Conducted experiments on four real-world large-scale graph datasets.

Inputted the graph snapshots into the graph representation learning module at a single time step.
